bonuses.sources: pills 'Personal Health Bonus' +25 army HP, 'Personal Strength Bonus' +25 army STR, captain Aydae base level 20 star 0 (guardsmen +20 HP / +20 STR)

common.note: Per-unit boosted HP is ROUNDED TO AN INTEGER before multiplying by count (ARC1 150x1.45=217.5 -> 218; E>ARC1 line 653x218=142,354). Strength-against damage uses base strength only (ARC1 653x50x0.67=21,876) while the base part uses (1 + army + group) = 1.45.

runs.note: CAT1 absent (left in 'removed from formation' by the account state). SW1 (specialist, 150x1.25=187.5->188) 473x188=88,924 dies before SP1/ARC1 (404x218=88,072).

Engineers get the highest troop HP so they die first: CAT2 23 -> 77,625; CAT1 41 -> 76,875; then SW1 76,704, ARC1 76,300, RD1 76,125 ... Engineers attack the generic 'monster' target with no features (CAT2 12,938 = 23 x 450 x 1.25; CAT1 12,813 = 41 x 250 x 1.25).
runs.journalEnemyFirst: 50 rounds, 34 hits. Order: WE, ED, BB, SG (monsters have the highest HP here), CAT2, CAT1, SW1, ARC1, RD1, ... Round 1 friendly hits: ED, BB, SG, then SW1 ARC1 RD1 ARC2 RD2 SP1 SP2 RD3 ARC3 SP3 CAT2 CAT1.

runs.note: Event strength is additive with the other strength bonuses: ED 7x4500x(1+0.25+1.30)=80,325 + features 58,275 = 138,600 (journal). The TOTAL strength card does not show the event (+25% army only). Stack counts unchanged by the event (HP unaffected).

Same counts as bonus-8stacks-dom200; only the battle changes: 8 enemy attacks per round. Journal: 26 rounds, 14 friendly hits — round 1: E kills RD1, ARC1 hits, E, RD2, E, ARC2, E, SP2, E, ARC3, E, SP3, E, RD3, E(8th) kills RD3?, then WE, ED, BB, SG hit; round 2: E kills WE, ED, E, BB, E, SG, E. Per-hit damage identical to the 4-stack run.
